# Bundled browser libraries

These unmodified browser distributions are served locally so a third-party script CDN is not required to start the app. License notices accompany each package.

- Leaflet 1.9.4, https://leafletjs.com/ (BSD-2-Clause)
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3, https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster (MIT)
- Esri Leaflet 3.0.19, https://github.com/Esri/esri-leaflet (Apache-2.0)

Map tiles, public-land imagery, and optional photos are external services. Bundling the libraries does not make those services available offline. No basemap tile prefetching is performed.
